m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read the handoff, the G2 adapter (decoupled_braking_input.py), the G2 result (gravity-once contract), and the production seams (session_braking, braking_view, scoreboard, estimate_batch/store, session_estimator, dashboard). Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff + G2 adapter + G2 result + production seams loaded; handoff complete
postconditions.satisfied_by: Read handoff, G2 adapter, G2 result, and all production seams in full; handoff complete (task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present)

m1-wire-frontier.title: Wire decoupled adapter as the canonical braking frontier input
m1-wire-frontier.imperative: In session_braking.prepare_braking_frontier, replace the per-driver clean_longitudinal_from_raw + gradient_at_positions loop with the G2 adapter's build_decoupled_braking_input: feed BrakingFrontierData with a_long = F_vehicle/m (gravity-free), theta = zeros, sigma_kin = per-sample sigma_a. Gravity counted ONCE (estimator z-map); BrakingView no longer re-subtracts g*sin(theta). ONE canonical braking input (adapter); clean_longitudinal_from_raw no longer the direct frontier a_long (still present: adapter anchor + throttle/coast). Add/extend unit tests in tests/unit/physics/layer2/ for the wired prepare_braking_frontier (synthetic, no FastF1). TDD/test-after: write tests, run green.

postconditions.statement: prepare_braking_frontier uses the adapter (theta=0, F_vehicle/m, per-sample sigma_a); braking tests pass

constraints: ONE canonical braking path (no dual/flagged input)

m2-scoreboard-terrain.title: Add optional terrain handle to scoreboard.CaseInputs
m2-scoreboard-terrain.imperative: Add an OPTIONAL theta/z pool to scoreboard.CaseInputs (additive/optional). Existing FLAT cases must stay byte-identical when no terrain supplied (default None). Extend tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_scoreboard.py to exercise both the FLAT-unchanged path and a supplied-terrain path. Keep existing scoreboard tests green.

preconditions.satisfied_by: m1 wiring complete and green (17 passed)

postconditions.statement: CaseInputs accepts optional terrain; FLAT path byte-identical without it; scoreboard tests pass

constraints: FLAT path byte-identical when no terrain supplied

m3-suite-green.title: Full touched-path suite green + simplification clean

postconditions.statement: full layer2 + physics unit suite green
simplification limits clean on touched paths

m4-repopulate-store.imperative: Write a repopulation script that builds a NEW store file (data/physics_estimates_g3wired.db, OLD preserved) with the wired braking input, for constructors RBR/Ferrari/McLaren/Williams/Mercedes across 2023-Q through the dashboard's max target round (15, Singapore). FORCE re-estimation. Capture a spot-circuit check that the wired braking knee (a_b/b_b from the store) matches the G2 synthesis a_b (deep floor preserved), and a pinned-ceiling verification note (did the cold ceiling gap collapse). Report runtime + manifest. Stay active / poll if backgrounded.
